0 END)) AS VLRBASE ,(SELECT SUM(C.VLRCOM) FROM TGFCOM C WHERE C.NUNOTAORIG = VCOM.NUNOTAORIG) AS VLRCOM ,(SELECT SUM(C.VLRCOM) FROM TGFCOM C WHERE C.NUNOTAORIG = VCOM.NUNOTAORIG AND C.NUFECHAMENTO=0) AS SALDOVLRCOM ,VCOM.COMLIQ ,NVL(CAB.AD_VLROUTROSFRETE,0) AS FRETE_OUTROS ,CAB.VLROUTROS as VLROUTROS ,VCOM.VLRDESDOB ,VCOM.VLRBAIXA ,/*(VCOM.VLRDESDOB/(CAB.VLRNOTA+CAB.VLROUTROS + NVL(CAB.AD_VLROUTROSFRETE,0)))*100 AS PERCPARCELA/*/ (VCOM.VLRDESDOB/(SELECT SUM(VLRDESDOB) FROM TGFFIN F WHERE F.NUNOTA =VCOM.NUNOTAORIG AND F.CODEMP = VCOM.CODEMP))*100 AS PERCPARCELA ,/*(VCOM.VLRBAIXA/(CAB.VLRNOTA+CAB.VLROUTROS + NVL(CAB.AD_VLROUTROSFRETE,0)))*100 AS PERCRECEBIDO */ (VCOM.VLRBAIXA/(SELECT SUM(VLRDESDOB) FROM TGFFIN F WHERE F.NUNOTA =VCOM.NUNOTAORIG AND F.CODEMP = VCOM.CODEMP))*100 AS PERCRECEBIDO ,VCOM.NUNOTAORIG ,VCOM.FINNUFIN ,(SELECT VEN.APELIDO FROM TGFVEN VEN WHERE VEN.CODVEND = VCOM.CODVEND) AS REPRESENTANTE ,(SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(CID.NOMECID))||'-'||RTRIM(LTRIM((UF.UF))) FROM TSIUFS UF,TSICID CID, TGFPAR PAR2 WHERE UF.CODUF = CID.UF AND CID.CODCID = PAR2.CODCID AND PAR2.CODPARC = VCOM.CODPARC) AS ENDERECO ,FIN.CODEMP ,FIN.DESDOBRAMENTO ,VCOM.CODVEND ,VCOM.CODPARC ,VCOM.NOMEPARC ,VCOM.NUMNOTA ,VCOM.DTVENC ,VCOM.DHBAIXA ,VCOM.DTFATUR ,VCOM.PERCCOM AS PERCCOM ,VCOM.NUFECHAMENTO ,VCOM.NUNOTAORIG AS NUNOTA , CASE WHEN VCOM.NUFECHAMENTO=0 AND VCOM.VLRBAIXA=0 THEN 'YELLOW' WHEN VCOM.NUFECHAMENTO=0 AND VCOM.VLRBAIXA>0 THEN '#98FB98' WHEN VCOM.NUFECHAMENTO>0 THEN '#00CED1' END BKCOLOR FROM VGFCOM_FECH VCOM , TGFCAB CAB , TGFFIN FIN WHERE CASE WHEN :P_TIPDATA = 'B' THEN VCOM.DHBAIXA ELSE VCOM.DTNEG END BETWEEN :P_PER.INI AND :P_PER.FIN AND (VCOM.CODVEND = :P_CODVEND OR :P_CODVEND IS NULL ) AND VCOM.FINNUFIN = FIN.NUFIN AND VCOM.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND (VCOM.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP OR :P_CODEMP IS NULL) AND (VCOM.NUMNOTA = :P_NUMNOTA OR :P_NUMNOTA IS NULL) /*AND VCOM.POSICAO_QUERY IN (3,4) --PELA BAIXA E RENEGOCIADA */ UNION SELECT CAB.VLRNOTA+CAB.VLROUTROS + NVL(CAB.AD_VLROUTROSFRETE,0)AS TOTALVENDA ,CAB.VLRNOTA+CAB.VLROUTROS-(CAB.VLRIPI+CAB.VLRSUBST + CASE WHEN CAB.TIPFRETE = 'S' THEN CAB.VLRFRETE ELSE 0 END) AS VLRBASE ,(SELECT SUM(C.VLRCOM) FROM TGFCOM C WHERE C.NUNOTAORIG = VCOM.NUNOTAORIG) AS VLRCOM ,(SELECT SUM(C.VLRCOM) FROM TGFCOM C WHERE C.NUNOTAORIG = VCOM.NUNOTAORIG AND C.NUFECHAMENTO=0) AS SALDOVLRCOM ,VCOM.VLRCOM AS COMLIQ ,NVL(CAB.AD_VLROUTROSFRETE,0) AS FRETE_OUTROS ,CAB.VLROUTROS as VLROUTROS ,FIN.VLRDESDOB ,FIN.VLRBAIXA /*,(FIN.VLRDESDOB/(CAB.VLRNOTA+CAB.VLROUTROS + NVL(CAB.AD_VLROUTROSFRETE,0)))*100 AS PERCPARCELA ,(FIN.VLRBAIXA/(CAB.VLRNOTA+CAB.VLROUTROS + NVL(CAB.AD_VLROUTROSFRETE,0)))*100 AS PERCRECEBIDO*/ ,(FIN.VLRDESDOB/(SELECT SUM(VLRDESDOB) FROM TGFFIN F WHERE F.NUNOTA =FIN.NUNOTA AND F.CODEMP = FIN.CODEMP))*100 AS PERCPARCELA ,(FIN.VLRBAIXA/(SELECT SUM(VLRDESDOB) FROM TGFFIN F WHERE F.NUNOTA =FIN.NUNOTA AND F.CODEMP = FIN.CODEMP))*100 AS PERCRECEBIDO ,VCOM.NUNOTAORIG ,FIN.NUFIN AS FINNUFIN ,(SELECT VEN.APELIDO FROM TGFVEN VEN WHERE VEN.CODVEND = VCOM.CODVEND) AS REPRESENTANTE ,(SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(CID.NOMECID))||'-'||RTRIM(LTRIM((UF.UF))) FROM TSIUFS UF,TSICID CID, TGFPAR PAR2 WHERE UF.CODUF = CID.UF AND CID.CODCID = PAR2.CODCID AND PAR2.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC) AS ENDERECO ,FIN.CODEMP ,FIN.DESDOBRAMENTO ,VCOM.CODVEND ,FIN.CODPARC ,PAR.NOMEPARC ,FIN.NUMNOTA ,FIN.DTVENC ,FIN.DHBAIXA ,CAB.DTFATUR ,0 AS PERCCOM ,VCOM.NUFECHAMENTO ,VCOM.NUNOTAORIG AS NUNOTA , CASE WHEN VCOM.NUFECHAMENTO=0 AND FIN.VLRBAIXA=0 THEN 'YELLOW' WHEN VCOM.NUFECHAMENTO=0 AND FIN.VLRBAIXA>0 THEN '98FB98' WHEN VCOM.NUFECHAMENTO>0 THEN '#00CED1' END BKCOLOR FROM TGFCOM VCOM , TGFCAB CAB , TGFFIN FIN, TGFPAR PAR WHERE CASE WHEN :P_TIPDATA = 'B' THEN FIN.DHBAIXA ELSE FIN.DTNEG END BETWEEN :P_PER.INI AND :P_PER.FIN AND (VCOM.CODVEND = :P_CODVEND OR :P_CODVEND IS NULL ) AND VCOM.NUFINORIG = FIN.NUFIN AND VCOM.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND FIN.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND (FIN.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP OR :P_CODEMP IS NULL) AND (CAB.NUMNOTA = :P_NUMNOTA OR :P_NUMNOTA IS NULL) /*AND VCOM.POSICAO_QUERY IN (3,4) --PELA BAIXA E RENEGOCIADA */ ORDER BY 25 DESC, 15, 8 DESC

grid.title: Financeiro Comissão a Pagar Representante
grid.expression: SELECT :A_NUFECHAMENTO AS NUFECHAMENTO,F.NUFIN, F.CODPARC, P.NOMEPARC,F.DTVENC, F.VLRDESDOB, F.VLRBAIXA, F.DHBAIXA, F.DHBAIXA, F.DTNEG, F.HISTORICO FROM TGFFIN F INNER JOIN TGFPAR P ON (F.CODPARC = P.CODPARC) WHERE F.NUFIN IN (SELECT MAX(NUFIN) FROM TGFCOM WHERE NUFECHAMENTO = :A_NUFECHAMENTO)
